stories.title: Yemen’s army strikes Sanaa after Houthi attack on Madinah power facility

en.title: Yemen's army strikes Sanaa after Houthi attack on Madinah power facility
en.summary: Yemen's army conducted attacks on sites in Sanaa following a Houthi drone strike on an electricity distribution station in Madinah that supplies power to the Prophet's Mosque, drawing condemnation from Islamic and Arab nations.

stories.title: Coalition: Terrorist Houthi Militia Targets Taibah Power Distribution Station in Madinah

en.title: Coalition: Terrorist Houthi Militia Targets Taibah Power Distribution Station in Madinah
en.summary: A Houthi militia group targeted the Taibah power distribution station in Madinah.

stories.title: Saudi Defense Minister Discusses Regional Security with Hegseth, Vautrin

en.title: Saudi Defense Minister Discusses Regional Security with Hegseth, Vautrin
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's defense minister held discussions on regional security matters with Hegseth and Vautrin.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia: Flydubai Captain, Co-Pilot Departed to UAE with Security Team

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Flydubai Captain, Co-Pilot Departed to UAE with Security Team
en.summary: A Flydubai captain and co-pilot left for the UAE accompanied by a security team.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia assisted all 174 FlyDubai passengers after emergency landing, interior ministry says

en.title: Saudi Arabia assisted all 174 FlyDubai passengers after emergency landing, interior ministry says
en.summary: Saudi Arabia provided logistical and necessary assistance to all passengers and crew after a FlyDubai flight bound for Israel made an emergency landing in Tabuk. Israeli officials indicated the Omani copilot attacked his colleague in the cockpit.

stories.title: Saudi Interior ministry: Flydubai co-pilot assaulted captain; both transferred to Abu Dhabi

en.title: Saudi Interior ministry: Flydubai co-pilot assaulted captain; both transferred to Abu Dhabi
en.summary: The FlyDubai copilot assaulted the captain during an emergency landing in Tabuk, injuring both men. After receiving medical clearance, both pilots were transferred to Abu Dhabi on Thursday.

stories.title: Arab, Muslim countries condemn Houthi drone attack on Madinah power station

en.title: Arab, Muslim countries condemn Houthi drone attack on Madinah power station
en.summary: Gulf states including the UAE, Bahrain, and Kuwait issued statements condemning a Houthi drone attack on a Madinah power distribution station that supplies electricity to the Prophet's Mosque.

stories.title: Saudi defence minister discusses regional security with US defence secretary

en.title: Saudi defence minister discusses regional security with US defence secretary
en.summary: Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman and US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth discussed their strategic defense partnership and coordinating efforts to strengthen regional security and stability.

stories.title: Houthi drone targeted power station supplying Prophet’s Mosque in Madinah

en.title: Houthi drone targeted power station supplying Prophet's Mosque in Madinah
en.summary: A Houthi drone attacked the Taibah power distribution station in Madinah on September 29, a facility supplying electricity to the Prophet's Mosque. The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen confirmed Houthi involvement based on investigations and drone wreckage examination.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Provides 224 Million Riyals to Support Yemen's Government Budget

en.title: Saudi Arabia Provides 224 Million Riyals to Support Yemen's Government Budget
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has provided 224 million riyals to support Yemen's government budget.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia launches safety investigation into Flydubai emergency landing in Tabuk

en.title: Saudi Arabia launches safety investigation into Flydubai emergency landing in Tabuk
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's National Transport Safety Center opened an investigation into Flydubai flight FZ1073's emergency landing at Tabuk airport. The center dispatched a team to examine circumstances and assess aviation safety aspects in coordination with relevant authorities.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia will respond decisively to any threat to its security

en.title: Saudi Arabia will respond decisively to any threat to its security
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman stated the Kingdom will respond decisively to threats aimed at undermining its security while reaffirming commitment to de-escalation and diplomacy. He made the remarks while inaugurating the third year activities of the Shoura Council's ninth session.

stories.title: ‎Tadawul's Sukuk/Bonds Market sees 57 negotiated deals worth SAR 7.8B in 9M 2026

en.title: Tadawul's Sukuk/Bonds Market sees 57 negotiated deals worth SAR 7.8B in 9M 2026
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange's Sukuk/Bonds Market recorded 57 negotiated deals totaling nearly 7.8 billion riyals during the first nine months of 2026. February experienced the highest trading activity at 3.3 billion riyals in deal values.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 29
en.summary: The Tadawul stock exchange will experience significant ownership changes on September 29.

stories.title: ‎Thimar files with CMA for capital hike via rights issue

en.title: Thimar files with CMA for capital hike via rights issue
en.summary: Thimar Development Holding Co. submitted an application to Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority to increase its capital by 130 million riyals through a rights issue. The company aims to support financial restructuring, strengthen liquidity and meet its obligations.

en.title: Raydan raises proposed capital cut to 80%
en.summary: Raydan Food Co. increased its proposed capital reduction to 80% from 70%, reducing capital from 73.14 million to 14.63 million riyals due to accumulated losses. The reduction aims to restructure the company.

stories.title: ‎Arabian Pipes signs SAR 103M contracts with Saudi Aramco

en.title: Arabian Pipes signs SAR 103M contracts with Saudi Aramco
en.summary: Arabian Pipes Company has secured steel pipe manufacturing and supply contracts valued at approximately SAR 103 million from Saudi Aramco, with a 10-month duration and financial impact expected in Q2 and Q3 2027.
